PhotoCraft Design System & Interactive Look-and-Feel Reference

Craft DS captures the complete visual language and interaction mechanics of PhotoCraft’s Rust/egui studio interface: dual-personality Pro Spectrum (#323232 / #535353 charcoal, #378ef0 Spectrum blue, pill buttons, checkboxes, 5-lock strips, Opacity: colons) and Studio Card/Pill (#141415 carbon, #8b7cf6 violet accent, near-white primary CTAs, pill switches, 30px round color chips), plus Classic Windows 2000 3D Bevel and desktop integrations (GNOME Adwaita, KDE Breeze, Solarized, Soft).

4. Three Distinct Layout & Surface Grammars Simultaneous Scoped Comparison

In PhotoCraft, themes control structural geometry & widget idioms in addition to color palettes
1. Pro Spectrum Grammar pro: true

Used by Pro Dark, Pro Medium, Pro Light Gray, and Pro Light. Flat panels (3/4/6px radii), 12px body text, 28px pill buttons, 3-line hamburger panel icon, toggle() → checkbox(), 5-icon lock strip, Opacity: colons, and 18×18px square overlapping color chips.

2. Studio Card / Pill Grammar round_chips: true

Used by Studio Dark/Light, Adwaita, Breeze, Solarized, and Soft. Rounded cards (6/8/12px radii), 12.5px body text, 24px pill tabs, 3-dot ellipsis menu, 30×17px iOS-style toggle switches, near-white primary CTAs, single lock button, and 30px round stacked color chips.

Lock
3. Classic Win2000 3D Bevel bevel: true

Used by Classic. Warm #d4d0c8 Win2000 gray, 0px sharp corners, #0a246a navy selection, raised 3D bevels (#ffffff top-left / #404040 bottom-right) on buttons & panels, sunken 3D bevels on inputs, and 10×16px rectangular slider thumbs.

Checkboxes & Grammar-Adaptive Toggles checkbox() • toggle()

In PhotoCraft, widgets::toggle(ui, theme, value) checks if theme.pro { return checkbox(ui, theme, value); }. Toggle between Pro and Studio themes in the top bar to watch the adaptive controls below morph between 14×14px Spectrum checkboxes and 30×17px iOS-style pill switches!

Adaptive widgets::toggle
Explicit Checkbox & Pill Switch
Value Fields, Scrubby Labels & Math Input (widgets/fields.rs) eval_arithmetic

Every numeric field supports: (1) dragging its scrubby label horizontally, (2) mouse wheel / ↑↓ stepping (Shift = 10×, Alt = 0.1×), and (3) typing arithmetic expressions (1920/2, (30+15)*2, 2^8, pi*10).
